title: SiteShrimp Photo Entry — M&E Inspection variant
description: Variant for services-focused inspections of mechanical, electrical, plumbing, ACMV, fire systems. Adds the specific service line, equipment / asset reference, and rating context so defects can be routed to the right specialist trade and tracked against equipment maintenance history.

me_service.description: M&E service line being inspected. Required — every M&E-frame photo has an identifiable service line. Drives routing to the right specialist sub-contractor.

equipment_id.description: Tag / asset ID / nameplate identifier for the equipment in the photo (free text — owner conventions vary). Empty when the photo isn't tied to a single piece of tagged equipment.

rating.description: Equipment rating from nameplate, e.g. '50 A 415V', '5 hp', '300 m³/h'. Free text — units depend on me_service.
